notes

Layers hold 4 parts (6 in the Hexagonal scenario); shapes have 1 to 4 layers (5 in Insane); part types include circle, square, star, diamond, pin, and crystal; nine colors; shape codes list layers bottom to top; floating parts are not allowed; separating crystals shatters them.
